title.zh-CN: 机器人模型、推理与规划

question.zh-CN: 怎样连接语言理解、世界预测、技能与执行反馈？
question.en: How are language understanding, world prediction, skills and execution feedback connected?

name.zh-CN: 视觉语言动作基础模型

problem.zh-CN: 从多模态任务输入产生机器人动作。
problem.en: Generate robot actions from multimodal task inputs.

research.zh-CN: 跨任务与跨本体泛化、动作编码。
research.en: Cross-task and cross-body generalization, action encoding.

industry.zh-CN: 特定机器人适配、时延和失败处置。
industry.en: Robot-specific adaptation, latency and failure handling.

compare.zh-CN: 未见任务、未见场景与实机表现。
compare.en: Unseen tasks, unseen scenes and physical-robot performance.

name.zh-CN: 世界模型与行动后果预测
name.en: World models and action consequence prediction

problem.zh-CN: 预测动作后的环境状态。

research.zh-CN: 视频、潜在状态与动作联合建模。
research.en: Joint video, latent-state and action modeling.

industry.zh-CN: 与控制器连接、误差识别与计算成本。
industry.en: Controller interfaces, error detection and compute cost.

compare.zh-CN: 行动条件预测误差与决策收益。
compare.en: Action-conditioned prediction error and decision benefit.

problem.zh-CN: 把需求拆成有约束的可执行步骤。
problem.en: Decompose requests into constrained executable steps.

research.zh-CN: 程序生成、可供性与任务运动联合规划。
research.en: Program generation, affordances and task-motion planning.

industry.zh-CN: 技能接口、先决条件与执行编排。

compare.zh-CN: 可执行率、长任务完成率与人工介入。
compare.en: Executability, long-task completion and human intervention.

problem.zh-CN: 利用历史经验适应用户与环境。
problem.en: Adapt to users and environments using past experience.

research.zh-CN: 检索、记忆更新与遗忘控制。
research.en: Retrieval, memory updates and forgetting control.

industry.zh-CN: 用户隔离、数据治理与版本管理。
industry.en: User isolation, data governance and versioning.

compare.zh-CN: 记忆有效性、更新代价与错误传播。
compare.en: Memory utility, update cost and error propagation.

problem.zh-CN: 识别偏离目标并重新组织行动。

research.zh-CN: 异常解释、进度估计与恢复策略。
research.en: Anomaly explanations, progress estimation and recovery policies.

industry.zh-CN: 监测接口、接管规则与安全退出。
industry.en: Monitoring interfaces, takeover rules and safe exits.

compare.zh-CN: 检出率、误报率与恢复后完成率。
compare.en: Detection, false alarms and completion after recovery.

name.zh-CN: 分层智能体与混合系统

problem.zh-CN: 连接慢推理、快速动作与传统控制。
problem.en: Connect slow reasoning, fast actions and classical control.

research.zh-CN: 层级接口、不确定性传递与协同学习。
research.en: Hierarchical interfaces, uncertainty propagation and joint learning.

industry.zh-CN: 时间预算、接口契约与失效隔离。
industry.en: Timing budgets, interface contracts and fault isolation.

compare.zh-CN: 全链路时延、约束满足与任务可靠性。
compare.en: Full-chain latency, constraint satisfaction and task reliability.
